identified.basis: The citation's 1831 census entry is the NAI index record for Robt Glasgow, Coltrim house 2, Lissane, read 5 November 2026. The household head is Robert of Coltrim (Glasgow-3941), the 1820 Drapers' lessee and 1827 tithe occupier there. The citation stays on the Unknown Glasgow (Glasgow-3905) profile only as comparison evidence; no kinship to Adam of Inishrush is shown.
